The '''Kashyyyk sword''' was a type of two-handed [[Sword/Legends|sword]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] which saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
